postings.title: Contract Payroll Manager (Workday)
postings.text:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.




POSITION SUMMARY

Saronic Technologies is seeking an experienced Contract Payroll Manager to lead payroll operations during a period of rapid company growth. This role owns end-to-end payroll processing in Workday, ensures compliance with multi-state and federal payroll regulations, and partners closely with People, Finance, and Legal to keep payroll accurate, timely, and audit-ready. This is a fixed-term contract engagement suited to a hands-on payroll leader who can step in immediately and run payroll independently.

Key Responsibilities

 - Own and manage end-to-end multi-state payroll processing in Workday for all employee types, including biweekly or semi-monthly cycles, off-cycle payments, and final pay

 - Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Workday payroll modules, including earnings/deduction codes, tax setups, retro pay, and integrations with time tracking and benefits systems

 - Ensure accurate calculation and timely remittance of federal, state, and local payroll taxes, and manage tax filings across all applicable jurisdictions

 - Lead payroll compliance efforts, including wage and hour law, FLSA classification, garnishments, and multi-state registration requirements

 - Partner with People, Finance, Total Rewards, and Legal teams on payroll-related matters, including new hires, terminations, leaves of absence, equity/bonus payouts, and benefits deductions

 - Manage and reconcile payroll general ledger entries, working closely with Accounting to support month-end close and payroll accruals

 - Prepare and review payroll reports, audits, and analytics for internal stakeholders and external auditors

 - Serve as the primary point of escalation for payroll discrepancies, employee inquiries, and system issues

 - Drive process improvements and Workday payroll optimizations to increase efficiency and reduce manual work

 - Maintain SOX-compliant payroll controls and documentation, supporting internal and external audit requests

 - Stay current on federal, state, and local payroll law changes and ensure timely implementation of required updates

Required Qualifications

 - 7+ years of progressive payroll experience, including at least 3 years in a payroll management or lead role

 - Deep, hands-on experience running payroll in Workday, including configuration, troubleshooting, and reporting

 - Proven track record owning multi-state payroll for a company of 500+ employees

 - Strong working knowledge of federal, state, and local payroll tax law, wage and hour regulations, and FLSA requirements

 - Experience partnering cross-functionally with People, Finance, and Legal teams on payroll matters

 - Experience supporting SOX controls, internal audits, or external payroll audits

 - Demonstrated ability to manage payroll independently with minimal onboarding ramp time

 - Advanced Excel/spreadsheet skills and strong attention to detail with high-volume, time-sensitive data

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain payroll matters clearly to employees and leadership

 - Ability to maintain strict confidentiality when handling sensitive compensation and personal data

Preferred Qualifications

 - Prior experience in a fast-growing, venture-backed, manufacturing, defense, or hardware technology company

 - Experience with Workday reporting tools (e.g., custom reports, calculated fields) beyond standard configuration

 - Experience with equity compensation payroll treatment (RSUs, stock options) and multi-entity or multi-country payroll

 - Experience implementing or migrating payroll systems onto Workday

Contract Details & Location

 - Engagement type: Fixed-term contract (duration to be confirmed based on business need)

 - Location: Open to on-site, hybrid, or remote depending on candidate location and business needs

 - Reports to: Director of Accounting Operations

 - Start: As soon as possible

postings.title: Senior Revenue Accountant
postings.text:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.




JOB OVERVIEW:

 - We are seeking an experienced and technically strong Senior Revenue Accountant to own the day-to-day execution of our revenue accounting and billing operations. This is a unique opportunity to join a newly established revenue accounting function at the ground level and help build the processes that will scale with Saronic's continued growth and complexity.

 - This role will be responsible for the full billing lifecycle of complex government contracts, from sales order validation through invoice submission and payment tracking, as well as drafting technical accounting memos and preparing monthly revenue entries under ASC 606. The ideal candidate combines strong accounting fundamentals with hands-on systems fluency and thrives in a fast-paced environment where ownership and follow-through matter.

 - The Revenue Accountant will work closely with the Senior Manager of Revenue Accounting and partner cross-functionally with Contracts, Business Development, and Finance to ensure revenue is recognized properly and cash is collected efficiently.
   

Key Responsibilities:

Billing Operations

Validate and approve sales orders in Salesforce and NetSuite for each Closed Won opportunity, including review of line items and milestone billing schedules on complex contracts with numerous CLINs and option CLINs.

 - Prepare and submit customer invoices in NetSuite and WAWF, including milestone eligibility review and CLIN reconciliation, ensuring invoices are accurate, timely, and compliant with contract terms.

 - Own invoice rejection resolution and resubmission, working with internal stakeholders and government systems to keep billing on track.

 - Maintain billing and payment status across internal tracking systems, including Overwatch, Salesforce approvals, and the Finance Receipts Tracker, at each billing and payment event.

Revenue Accounting 

 - Draft ASC 606 technical accounting memos for new contract awards and contract modifications, supporting review and sign-off by revenue accounting leadership.

 - Prepare monthly revenue journal entries and supporting reconciliations, ensuring accurate recognition and reporting in accordance with ASC 606.

 - Support external audit requests related to revenue, billing, and receivables, maintaining audit-ready documentation.

Process Improvement & Collaboration

 - Identify and recommend improvements to billing and revenue workflows, supporting automation and systems initiatives across NetSuite and Salesforce.

 - Partner with Contracts, Business Development, and Finance to ensure contract terms, billing schedules, and revenue treatment are aligned throughout the award lifecycle.

Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA or active CPA candidacy a plus.

 - 4 – 7 years of relevant accounting experience; public accounting, government contracting, or revenue/billing operations experience preferred.

 - Demonstrated knowledge of ASC 606 revenue recognition; experience independently drafting technical accounting memos required.

 - Experience with ERP and CRM systems (NetSuite and Salesforce preferred); familiarity with WAWF or other government invoicing systems highly desirable.

 - Experience in defense, aerospace, or government contracting highly desirable, including familiarity with CLIN-based contract structures and milestone billing.

 - Ability to operate independently and exercise sound judgment in a lean team environment, including cross-functional communication with varying audiences and stakeholders

 - Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and take ownership of end-to-end processes in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.




BENEFITS

Medical Insurance: Comprehensive health insurance plans covering a range of services

Saronic pays 100% of the premium for employees and 80% for dependents

Dental and Vision Insurance: Coverage for routine dental check-ups, orthodontics, and vision care

Saronic pays 100% of the premium under the basic plan for employees and 80% for dependents

Time Off: Generous PTO and Holidays

Parental Leave: Paid maternity and paternity leave to support new parents

Competitive Salary: Industry-standard salaries with opportunities for performance-based bonuses

Retirement Plan: 401(k) plan with company match

Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success

Life and Disability Insurance: Basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage

Pet Insurance: Discounted pet insurance options including 24/7 Telehealth helpline

Additional Perks: Free lunch benefit and unlimited free drinks and snacks in the office

postings.title: Accounts Payable Manager
postings.text:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.



We are seeking an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to lead and scale our accounts payable function during a period of rapid growth. This role will manage a team of AP professionals and oversee high-volume, complex payables across domestic and international operations. You will play a key role in improving processes and ensuring timely, accurate payments in a complex manufacturing environment.

 - Oversee end-to-end accounts payable operations, including invoice processing, vendor payments and expense reimbursements

 - Manage domestic and international vendor payments, including foreign currency transactions and compliance with local regulations

 - Partner closely with Procurement, Accounting, Legal and Finance teams to ensure proper GL coding and streamline workflows

 - Process and submit year-end 1099 reports and forms, prepare reports for proper allocation of sales taxes by state, and maintain compliance with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations

 - Own month-end close activities, including reconciliations and reporting

 - Experience operating in a fast-growing, complex organization

 - Experience with international payments, multi-currency environments, and global vendors

 - Proficiency with modern ERP systems and AP automation tools (NetSuite experience strongly preferred)

 - Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills

 - Ability to thrive in a high-growth, deadline-driven environment with evolving priorities

Preferred Qualifications 

 - Experience in a manufacturing environment

Physical Demands

 - Visual acuity to read screens, documents, and reports.  

 - Occasional reaching, bending, or stooping to access file drawers, cabinets, or office supplies.  

 - Lifting and carrying items up to 20 pounds occasionally (e.g., office supplies, packages).

postings.title: Senior FP&A Analyst – Corporate Finance
postings.text:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.




JOB OVERVIEW

We are seeking a Senior FP&A Analyst to join our Finance team as a key contributor to our Corporate Finance function. This role will support company-wide financial planning, consolidated reporting, and strategic decision-making across the organization.

You will play a critical role in connecting business performance with financial outcomes - owning core planning processes, delivering executive-level insights, and helping leadership make informed decisions around growth, investment, and resource allocation.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working across functions, building scalable planning and reporting processes, and bringing financial clarity to a fast-moving, high-growth environment.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Support company-wide financial planning and analysis, including annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-range planning.

 - Own consolidated financial reporting, including budget vs. actuals, forecast updates, variance analysis, and management reporting.

 - Partner cross-functionally with business leaders to understand key drivers of performance and translate them into actionable financial insights.

 - Build and maintain financial models that support operating forecasts, headcount planning, cash planning, and strategic decision-making.

 - Prepare executive-level reporting and presentation materials for senior leadership, including monthly business reviews, board materials, and ad hoc analyses.

 - Analyze company performance across departments and functions, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities to improve financial outcomes.

 - Support capital allocation and investment decision-making through scenario analysis, sensitivity modeling, and ROI assessments.

 - Partner with Accounting during month-end close to ensure accurate financial reporting and alignment between actuals and forecasts.

 - Help drive improvements in financial processes, reporting tools, and planning frameworks to support a scalable finance function.

 - Contribute to strategic finance initiatives such as KPI development, operating metric tracking, and process standardization across the organization.




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, consulting, or a related analytical role.

 - Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with experience building integrated forecasts and decision-support models.

 - Experience with consolidated planning, variance analysis, and management reporting.

 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and communicate financial insights clearly to business and executive stakeholders.

 - Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with evolving priorities and multiple work streams.

 - Strong communication skills, including experience preparing materials for senior leadership.

 - Experience improving financial reporting, systems, or tools (e.g., NetSuite, Adaptive, Foundry, or similar).

 - Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field; advanced degree or certification (MBA, CFA) is a plus.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in high-growth, manufacturing, defense, aerospace, robotics, or deep-tech environments.

 - Familiarity with headcount planning, cash flow forecasting, and corporate performance metrics.
   
   Experience supporting board reporting, long-range planning, or strategic finance initiatives.

 - Exposure to capital planning, investment analysis, or enterprise-level financial planning processes.

 - Comfortable interpreting accounting data and translating financial results into actionable business insights.

 - Experience partnering with accounting teams as needed
